_scenario.title: SaaS Account Executive
_scenario.persona: Closes mid-market software deals: pricing pushback, security reviews and an angry renewal.

all_tasks.task_details: Walk through revised pricing before their internal review
Technical deep-dive with their IT team on API rate limits and SSO
Discuss proposal feedback and next steps
Send the signed NDA countersignature back - one attachment, nothing else needed
Apology call re: the failed data import, confirm the fix landed
Send the SOC 2 report and security questionnaire responses
Final pitch to the buying committee ahead of their board review
Commercial terms negotiation with their procurement head
Intro call - qualify budget and timeline

all_followups.followup_details: Circle back after they review the demo recording with their ops team
Waiting on renewal decision from procurement - has been snoozed twice already
Confirm the data import issue is resolved and offer service credit
Confirm which of the two onboarding dates they want - yes/no reply
Check whether legal cleared the DPA after receiving the security pack
He asked to be called back after Eid holidays

all_notes.content: Budget is approved (roughly {45k} for year one) but they are actively trialling Vendor X next week. Wants a decision before the 10th. Per-seat price is the sticking point, not the product.
Decision maker (Angela, CFO) travels from the 8th, so Monday's pitch is the only real shot before their board review on the 10th. She cares about payback period, not features.
Said to check back "after the new fiscal year starts" which is September for them. Was our warmest lead in Q2 - 400 stores, biggest deal in the pipeline. Nothing scheduled since.
Very unhappy. Their inventory sync failed for 3 days and nobody told them. Used the phrase "if this happens again we're out". Renewal is in 6 weeks.
Their IT lead is the real blocker - worried about API rate limits at their volume (2M events/day) and wants SSO via Okta. If IT signs off, procurement is a formality.
Renewal sitting with procurement. Omar sounded like he has checked out - mentioned his team is being reorganised and he may not own this account much longer.
Healthcare, so security review is the whole gate. Once SOC 2 + DPA clear legal she said she can sign within the week. No competitor in play.

all_calls.transcript: Mahdi: Thanks for making time, Rahim. Did the ops team get through the demo recording? Rahim: They did. Honestly the product is fine, the team liked the reporting. The problem is the per-seat number. At 60 seats we're looking at nearly double what we modelled. Mahdi: Understood. What did you model against? Rahim: Vendor X quoted us a flat platform fee. We start trialling them Monday. Mahdi: Let me do this - I'll get you a revised quote with the annual commitment discount and a tiered seat band, and I'll send it over by Saturday. I'll also loop in our solutions engineer so your ops lead can ask implementation questions directly. Rahim: If the numbers land closer we can decide before the 10th. Our internal review is Monday morning, so anything after Saturday is too late. Mahdi: Saturday it is. Rahim: Also, can you confirm whether the reporting module is included or an add-on? Nobody's been clear on that.
Voicemail: Hi Omar, Mahdi here, just following up on the renewal paperwork with procurement. Give me a call back when you get a chance. Thanks.

Tanvir: I need to understand how this happened. Our inventory sync was down three days and we found out from a customer complaint, not from you. Mahdi: You're right, and I'm sorry. The sync job failed silently after a schema change on our side. Tanvir: Silently. So your monitoring doesn't cover the thing we actually pay for. Mahdi: The alerting gap is real. Engineering has shipped the fix and added an alert on sync lag. Tanvir: I've had to explain this to my warehouse director twice. Look, I like your team, but if this happens again we're out. Our renewal is in six weeks and I'm going to be asked hard questions. Mahdi: Let me get you two things - a written incident summary with what changed, and I'll take the service credit question to my manager today. Tanvir: Send the incident summary by end of week. And I want to know whether we get proactive alerts going forward or whether I'm still finding out from customers. Mahdi: I'll confirm both in writing. Tanvir: Fine. Call me Sunday.

Farhan: So commercially we're aligned, it's my IT lead you need to convince. Mahdi: Happy to. What's his main concern? Farhan: Two things. Volume - we push about two million events a day and he's seen your published rate limit of 500 requests per minute and done the maths. And SSO, we're an Okta shop and he won't approve anything without it. Mahdi: On rate limits, the published number is the default tier; enterprise accounts get raised limits and there's a bulk ingest endpoint designed for exactly that volume. I'll send him the architecture doc. Farhan: Send it before Sunday's session, he reads everything in advance. Mahdi: Will do. Okta is supported on the enterprise plan, SAML and SCIM provisioning. Farhan: Good. One more thing, he'll ask about data residency - our contracts require data stays in-region. Mahdi: Let me check which regions we have available and come back to you. Farhan: If IT clears it, procurement is a formality. We want to be live before Q4.

Nadia: Where are we on the security pack? Mahdi: I'll send the SOC 2 report and our completed questionnaire on Thursday the 3rd. Nadia: Perfect. Once legal has it, the DPA review takes about three days and then I can sign. We've allocated the budget this quarter so I'd like to close this month. Mahdi: Any other stakeholders? Nadia: Just legal. Nobody else is being evaluated, we chose you in July. Mahdi: Great, I'll get the pack over Thursday and check in Tuesday on the DPA. Nadia: Sounds good.

Sophia: Quick one - I signed the NDA and sent it over, can you countersign and send it back? Legal needs it on file before we can start onboarding. Mahdi: Of course, I'll get that back to you tomorrow. Sophia: Also we're deciding between the 15th and the 22nd for onboarding, I'll confirm by tomorrow. Nothing else from me.

all_messages.subject: Revised pricing - coming Saturday
all_messages.content: Rahim, good speaking earlier. Revised quote with the annual discount and tiered seat bands will be with you Saturday, plus I'll copy in our solutions engineer.

all_messages.subject: Re: Revised pricing - coming Saturday
all_messages.content: Thanks. Please make sure the quote states clearly whether the reporting module is included. That question came up in our last two internal discussions and nobody could answer it. Internal review is Monday 9am.
Can we move Monday's pitch earlier - today or tomorrow first thing? Angela's travel got moved up. If not we may have to push past the board review.

all_messages.subject: Security pack?
all_messages.content: Hi Mahdi, I thought the SOC 2 report and questionnaire were coming Thursday? Legal has a slot open Tuesday and if they don't have the documents by tomorrow we lose the week. Can you confirm when it's going out?

all_messages.subject: Renewal paperwork
all_messages.content: Hi Omar, checking in on the renewal - is there anything procurement needs from us to move this along?

all_messages.subject: Re: Renewal paperwork
all_messages.content: Following up on the below - happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

all_messages.subject: Incident summary + service credit
all_messages.content: Following our call - I need the written incident summary by end of week, and an answer on the service credit. My warehouse director is asking whether we should be looking at alternatives. Please don't let this slip.

all_messages.subject: Architecture doc for tomorrow
all_messages.content: Reminder that Kamruzzaman (our IT lead) wants to read the architecture doc before tomorrow's session. He also asked again about data residency options. Without the doc in advance he'll want to reschedule.

all_messages.subject: Catching up after fiscal year start
all_messages.content: Kamal, as discussed I'll reach back out once your new fiscal year is underway. Enjoy the quieter few weeks.

all_messages.subject: NDA - signed copy attached
all_messages.content: Signed copy attached. Please countersign and return. Also let's lock onboarding for the 22nd, the 15th is too tight for my team.
Sorry I missed your call, was travelling for the holidays. Back at my desk from the 5th, call me any time after that.
